premises.text: Hundreds of millions have hearing loss but few get treated because aids are burdensome, costly, and uncool
premises.evidence_span: 650 million people worldwide can't. They're suffering of hearing loss. And only 1 out of 40 gets treated

premises.text: Audiology testing is squeezed into a smartphone app with headphone calibration and frequency tone tests
premises.evidence_span: we took the whole audiology setup and process and squeezed it into a smartphone, so I can take the next opportunity to test them at home

premises.text: Phone mic, processor, and speakers generate personalized hearing enhancement for digital audio and live ambient sound
premises.evidence_span: The smartphone has all the components of a hearing aid. It has a microphone. It has a processor and it has speakers. So we can generate his personalized hearing enhancement settings and show him directly the benefits of hearing better again

premises.text: Dedicated smart hearing enhancer uses phone only for initial setup and occasional fine-tuning
premises.evidence_span: we're developing a dedicated smart hearing enhancer where the phone is only used for the initial setup and for fine tuning from time to time. But elsewise, the phone is not needed

premises.text: Cloud connection lets users change settings anytime with MIMI guidance and improves fitting algorithms from multi-user data
premises.evidence_span: you connect it to the cloud and that enables you to change the settings wherever and whenever while getting guidance from MIMI. But it's not only one user, it's many users and we can take that data to constantly improve our fitting algorithm

premises.text: Monetization: free basic app, $5/month premium cloud, $40 subscription for dedicated earpiece with insurance/service
premises.evidence_span: The basic version of the app is for free. The premium version with the cloud support comes for $5 a month. And if you want to have the dedicated earpiece, we also offer that in a subscription model with device insurance included and service for $40

value.text: Make hearing enhancement more accessible, affordable, and attractive by lowering the living-room entry barrier
value.evidence_span: we're making hearing enhancement more accessible by really lowering the entry barrier for people like my father by bringing it into the living room

secondary_value.text: More affordable and better via optimized distribution and fitting
secondary_value.evidence_span: We make it more affordable and better by optimizing the distribution and fitting process

causal_links.evidence_span: bringing it into the living room

notes: Age demographics used as framing for accessibility, not separate premise. Advanced audiology tests folded into smartphone test premise.
